# GitGraph

**Class:** `UltraCanvasGitGraph` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasGitGraph.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasGitGraph.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasGitGraph.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A repository history as lanes or git-flow swimlanes

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasGitGraphExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasGitGraphExamples.md)
- [UltraCanvasGitGraphProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasGitGraphProposal.md)
- [UltraCanvasSmoothScroll](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasSmoothScroll.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasGitGraph> CreateGitGraph( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasGitGraph(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).
